description: This Java class 'SecurityUtil' provides security-related utility methods for permission checks, JWT token generation and validation, and protection against Freemarker template injection in the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: SecurityUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing security functions such as permission checks, JWT handling, and security protections.

methods.name: hasUserLoginAdminPermission
methods.description: Checks if a user has at least one admin permission.

methods.name: hasUserLoginMorePermissionThan
methods.description: Determines if one user has more permissions than another, returning missing permissions.

methods.name: checkMultiLevelAdminPermissionValidity
methods.description: Validates if a permission is covered by multi-level admin permissions.

methods.name: generateJwtToAuthenticateUserLogin
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for user login authentication, salted with user ID and current password.

methods.name: authenticateUserLoginByJWT
methods.description: Verifies the coherence of a JWT token with a user login ID.

methods.name: containsFreemarkerInterpolation
methods.description: Prevents Freemarker template injection by inspecting request parameters, URI, and content.

methods.name: containsFreemarkerInterpolation
methods.description: Checks if a string contains Freemarker interpolation patterns, and blocks request if so.
